seoTitle: Set Up Alerts & Reminders in Smartsheet Easily
metaDescription: Configure date-driven alerts and reminders in Smartsheet, personalize the message content, and target recipients with conditional rules.
intro: Missed deadlines are usually a communication problem, not a planning one. Smartsheet's Automation menu lets you set up alerts that fire automatically before, on, or after a due date. This guide covers building a reminder workflow, customizing the message, and limiting who gets notified.

steps.heading: Open the Automation menu
steps.body: From your active sheet, open the Automation menu to access the workflow builder dashboard.

steps.heading: Build the alert's basic structure
steps.body: Choose Triggers, Conditions, and Actions to define how and when the alert fires.

steps.heading: Set reminder timing
steps.body: Configure the reminder to send a specific number of days before a milestone, on the due date, or when a task is overdue.

steps.heading: Choose your recipients
steps.body: Send alerts to specific assigned contacts, entire team groups, or external emails as needed.

steps.heading: Personalize and filter
steps.body: Pull row information like Task Name and Status into the message, and add conditional rules so reminders only trigger for incomplete tasks.

faq.question: Can I remind someone a few days before a task is due?
faq.answer: Yes, reminder timing can be set to a specific number of days before a milestone, or on the exact due date.

faq.question: Can alerts go to external people outside my team?
faq.answer: Yes, delivery options let you send alerts to assigned contacts, team groups, or external email addresses.

faq.question: Will completed tasks still trigger reminders?
faq.answer: No, conditional rules let you restrict alerts so they only fire when a task status is still Not Started or In Progress.

faq.question: Can I personalize the reminder message?
faq.answer: Yes, you can dynamically pull row data like Task Name and Status into the email subject or body.
